steps.message: I will use Azure Resource Lookup.

arguments.command: az graph query -q "Resources | where isempty(tags.Owner) or isempty(tags.CostCenter) or isempty(tags.Environment) | project name, missingOwner=isempty(tags.Owner), missingCostCenter=isempty(tags.CostCenter), missingEnvironment=isempty(tags.Environment)"

results.content: vm-api-01 Owner; stlogs CostCenter; app-prod Environment.

steps.message: Using policy assignment Corp-Required-Tags as the source of truth, vm-api-01 is missing Owner, stlogs is missing CostCenter, and app-prod is missing Environment. The query checked the named required tags against each resource.
